title: The Map of the Yard with Two X's
youtube_title: The Map of the Yard with Two X's | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Yelena is just outside the fun, close to a map that needed two X marks, not one. Nim changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Yelena has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
